issue.intent: L1 Network Connectivity Troubleshooting via Command Line
issue.sop_title: L1 Network Connectivity Troubleshooting via Command Line

steps.description: Verify local IP configuration and detect DHCP failure (169.254.x.x address).
steps.output_parse_instruction: Inspect output. If IPv4 Address starts with 169.254.x.x, set 'dhcp_failure' to 'true'. Extract Default Gateway IPv4 address into variable 'default_gateway_ip'. Record active adapter name (Ethernet/Wi-Fi) into variable 'active_adapter'.

steps.description: Release, renew, and flush network settings to resolve DHCP lease issues.
steps.danger_warning: Network connection will drop temporarily during release/renew.
steps.output_parse_instruction: Inspect output of 'ipconfig /renew'. If IPv4 Address still starts with 169.254.x.x, set 'dhcp_renewal_failure' to 'true'.

steps.description: Test local TCP/IP stack functionality (loopback ping).
steps.output_parse_instruction: Count replies. If fewer than 4 replies, set 'local_stack_failure' to 'true'.

steps.description: Test connectivity to the default gateway.
steps.output_parse_instruction: Count replies. If fewer than 4 replies, set 'gateway_connectivity_failure' to 'true'.
Count replies. If fewer than 4 replies, set 'external_connectivity_failure' to 'true'.

steps.description: Trace the network path to 8.8.8.8 to isolate upstream failures.
steps.output_parse_instruction: Inspect hops. If first 1-2 hops show 'Request timed out', set 'local_gateway_failure' to 'true'. If later hops time out, set 'upstream_failure' to 'true'.
Inspect output. If 'DNS request timed out' or 'Can't find www.google.com', set 'dns_resolution_failure' to 'true'.
